aerobic.title: Aerobic response
aerobic.efficiencyFactorHint: Weighted power per heartbeat. Rising over time at the same training load means your aerobic engine is getting stronger.
aerobic.variabilityIndexHint: Weighted power divided by average power. 1.00 is perfectly steady; above 1.10 means surging or interval riding.
aerobic.decouplingHint: How far your power-to-heart-rate ratio drifted from the first half of the ride to the second. Under 5% is generally considered good durability.
aerobic.decouplingCaveat: Heart-rate drift is also pushed up by heat, dehydration and caffeine, so read a single ride's figure in context rather than as a pure fitness score.
aerobic.wBalBasis: W′ balance computed against CP {cp} W and W′ {wPrime}, fitted from your power bests as of this ride.

decouplingReasons.too_short: Not measured: the ride was too short. Decoupling needs about an hour of steady riding to mean anything.
decouplingReasons.no_power: Not measured: this ride has no power data.
decouplingReasons.no_hr: Not measured: this ride has no heart-rate data.
decouplingReasons.degenerate_hr: Not measured: the heart-rate data from this ride is unusable.
decouplingReasons.variable_effort: Not measured: this was an interval or otherwise surging session, where the figure would describe the intervals rather than your aerobic durability.
decouplingReasons.stream_mismatch: Not measured: the power and heart-rate recordings from this ride don't line up closely enough to compare them.
decouplingReasons.uneven_pacing: Not measured: the two halves were ridden at markedly different intensities, so the figure would reflect your pacing rather than your aerobic durability.
